name: Rowbly factory should not depend on git sync.
description: Git sync is a seperate plugin from rowbly factory and we do not want to create a dependency. If the git plugin is enabled, the factory skill should do a sync. If the plugin is not enabled, skip the sync. Currently if one git sync fails, rowbly factory skill will stop. Change instructions so agent can try up to 3 times, with exponential backoff between tries.
